llm_response.reason: The website claims to sell Gerard Darel products with discounts and free shipping but shows multiple scam indicators: it provides no company identification or business contact info, has no functioning site navigation (no hyperlinks present), does not list a physical address or business number, and uses a suspicious domain name unaffiliated with the official brand. These traits match several core characteristics of scam sites, including ambiguous customer information privacy, unclear business identity, and imitation of legitimate e-commerce.
